name: @keel-engine/dungeon
description: packs/dungeon: an action-RPG dungeon's dressing as styled objects -- barrels, crates, bones, skulls, chains, banners, altars, bookshelves, tables, rubble, cobwebs, stains, urns, sarcophagi, chests, weapon racks, cages, torches, braziers, candles, crystals, thrones, statues -- with look profiles per act (crypt, cave, forge, ruin), destructible and openable flags, and flame sockets for the lights.
